issue.title: Tests read ambient SASE_TUI_PERF/SASE_TUI_GC_CENSUS, so three TUI nodes fail in every agent shell

task_type_fields.impact: Every agent's `sase tool run check` reports these three nodes as KNOWN failures, which hides real regressions in the same files and generates repeat noise. Four phases of epic sase-1nn (sase-1nn.2 note #1, sase-1nn.3 note #1, sase-1nn.4 note #1, sase-1nn.6 note #3) each recorded them as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP. CI is unaffected because runners never export these variables. The fourth node in that cluster, `test_app_import_budget`, still fails with the variables unset and belongs to sase-1ic, not this bead.
task_type_fields.location: tests/conftest.py (no scrub of SASE_TUI_PERF / SASE_TUI_GC_CENSUS); src/sase/main/ace_tmux_support.py:16 _PROFILING_ENV_DEFAULTS; src/sase/ace/tui/util/gc_policy.py:52 ENV_CENSUS
task_type_fields.repro:
SASE agent shells inherit `SASE_TUI_PERF=1` and `SASE_TUI_GC_CENSUS=1` (ACE's tmux launcher seeds `SASE_TUI_PERF` through `_PROFILING_ENV_DEFAULTS` in `src/sase/main/ace_tmux_support.py:16`; `SASE_TUI_GC_CENSUS` is read as `ENV_CENSUS` in `src/sase/ace/tui/util/gc_policy.py:52`). `tests/conftest.py` scrubs ambient `GIT_CONFIG_*` but never these two, so three TUI nodes fail in every such shell and pass once the variables are unset (verified 2026-10-23 on master 62c5934eb6, sase_14 workspace venv):

```bash
A="tests/ace/tui/util/test_gc_policy.py::test_freeze_happens_once tests/ace/tui/util/test_gc_policy.py::test_census_off_by_default tests/ace/tui/test_statistics_perf.py::test_populated_perf_renderable_covers_every_panel"
.venv/bin/python -m pytest $A -q                                          # 3 failed
env -u SASE_TUI_PERF -u SASE_TUI_GC_CENSUS .venv/bin/python -m pytest $A -q  # 3 passed
```

Failure messages with the variables set:
- `test_freeze_happens_once`: `assert 3 == 2` on `_Collector.collections` (the census adds a collection).
- `test_census_off_by_default`: `Left contains one more item: {'event': 'tui_gc_census', ...}`.
- `test_populated_perf_renderable_covers_every_panel`: `assert 'SASE_TUI_PERF off' in <rendered Statistics perf panel>`.

Fix: scrub `SASE_TUI_PERF` and `SASE_TUI_GC_CENSUS` (and consider the sibling `SASE_TUI_TRACE`, also seeded by `_PROFILING_ENV_DEFAULTS`) in an autouse fixture in `tests/conftest.py`, so tests that need them opt in with `monkeypatch.setenv`. Then confirm the three nodes pass with the variables exported.
